meta.title: Task progress
meta.description: Shows the running task's progress bar, phase, and next node, and marks every milestone the evaluator supersedes as a node with hover details and the time that milestone took. The session's sidebar row also carries a progress ring. The session's own model records checkpoints at milestones (report_progress); a side-channel evaluator fills in when it does not. Nothing is shown once the task ends or the session is idle.
